description: Design reference from the Signal Flow prototype (Claude Design export, inline styles). The React version is not built yet, so rebuild this structure with the listed Carbon components and --at-* tokens; do not copy the prototype markup, which fails validate_page. 88px left rail (Research Projects, Platform Insights) plus a project header and a step menu grouped Plan / Analyze / Deliver (8 numbered steps). A step is locked until its prerequisite exists; render a locked step as a SideNavLink with aria-disabled and a visible hint (for example 'Save the test plan first'). Enabled flags and hints come from one endpoint (GET /projects/:id/stage), never from the component. Routes: /projects, /projects/:id/{plan|tasks|transcripts|themes|journey|prio|requirements|stories}, /insights/{themes|case-studies|onboarding}.
